name: Last-digit behavior of products and powers
definition: The final digit of a product depends only on the final digits of what you multiplied. Powers of a fixed number therefore cycle through a short list of last digits, so you can name the last digit of something astronomically large without computing it.
recognizeWhen: what is the units digit of a huge power
the answer choices differ only in their last digit
a product of many numbers ends in how many zeros
multiply a long string of numbers together
misconceptions: I tried to actually calculate the whole power on paper and ran out of time.
I found the cycle of last digits but started counting the cycle at zero instead of one.
I thought the last digit of a sum works the same way as a product without checking.
